content.text: intracardiac causes of pump failure that result in
▪︎signs of HF (⇡ JVP/distended neck veins, dyspnea,
drop in BP when change from sitting/supine
: reflex tachycardia & vasoconstriction impaired (d/t autonomic dysfunction) or overwhelmed ⇢ dependent pooling of blood ⇢ hypotension & ⇣ cerebral perfusion
: faintness, dizziness, confusion, or blurred vision that occur soon after standing & resolve rapidly w/ lying down; +/- syncope
: BP/HR measured after 5min supine & at 1 & 3min after standing
▪︎avoid triggers, adjust dosage of offending medications
▪︎abrupt onset of hypotension followed by syncope
: trigger activates vagus nerve ⇢ enhanced parasympathetic response ⇢ peripheral vasodilation & ⇣ HR, BP, & contractility
